producthunt.label: Product Hunt
producthunt.notes: Prefer Product Hunt API v2 when PRODUCT_HUNT_TOKEN is available; otherwise Jina/OrangeBot fallback must be marked.

hackernews.label: HN Algolia
hackernews.notes: Keep Launch HN and strict Show HN; ordinary stories are audit/all-signals only.

github.label: GitHub Release
github.notes: Default product report uses Releases only; Trending/Search are recall audit sources.

huggingface.label: Hugging Face API
huggingface.dateRule: lastModified or createdAt inside radar window
huggingface.notes: Models belong in Models & Infra; Spaces can be product signals.

aihot.label: AIHOT
aihot.dateRule: RSS pubDate or daily page date
aihot.notes: Use as discovery source; upgrade evidence to original official/social link when possible.

xhs_dealflow.label: XHS Dealflow
xhs_dealflow.dateRule: XHS search recent filter plus note timestamp when available
xhs_dealflow.notes: Best-effort domestic signal; unavailable is not a main pipeline failure.
